mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits nortriptyline metabolism and may displace it from protein binding, increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and tricyclic antidepressant toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for nortriptyline toxicity signs (tremor, confusion, arrhythmias, anticholinergic effects); consider nortriptyline dose reduction and ECG monitoring; measure nortriptyline levels if available.
